title: EOIP Data Directory Manifest
description: Index of all data artifacts in the EOIP data directory. Content-addressed files use SHA-256 filenames for deduplication and integrity verification.

autodemo/raw.description: Content-addressed raw source events captured during autodemo pipeline runs. Each JSON file conforms to the source_event.schema.json contract.

FRD/jira.description: Jira issue events from the Fraud & Risk Detection (FRD) project in the MFS enterprise demo.

PAY/jira.description: Jira issue events from the Payment Gateway (PAY) project in the MFS enterprise demo.

git.description: Git commit events captured from the demo repository history.

jira.description: Cross-project Jira events not partitioned by project key.

demo_enterprise.description: Northstar Commerce enterprise demo scenario pack with pre-built graph edges and vertices.

ontology.description: Enterprise ontology seed data: type hierarchies, relationship constraints, and SHACL-equivalent validation rules.

files.enterprise-type-hierarchy.json: Canonical entity types and relationship types across 8 graph domains (code, work, knowledge, identity, operations, evidence, compliance, design).
files.relationship-constraints.json: Cardinality, uniqueness, existence, temporal, and cross-domain constraint rules.

seed.description: Default taxonomy and classification data for bootstrapping new EOIP deployments.

files.default-taxonomy.json: Standard taxonomies for work item statuses, priorities, incident severities, languages, compliance frameworks, and graph domains.

integrity.verification_command: python -c "import json, hashlib, pathlib; [print(f'{hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]}  {p}') for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('data').rglob('*.json'))]"
integrity.note: Content-addressed files in autodemo/raw/ have filenames equal to their payload hash; verify with: sha256sum <file> and compare to filename.
